name: Ahanu
summary: Couriers arriving in Thunder Bluff can find Ahanu in Hewa's Armory. He crafts and trades leather armor for travelers and young braves setting out across Mulgore and the wider plains, and helps new couriers find their way across the bluffs.

sections.title: Merchant of Hewa's Armory
sections.body: Ahanu works the hides his friend Jahan Hawkwing sends from the Crossroads. In Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise, he crafts durable leather gear for those who travel Kalimdor's grasslands. Travelers arriving by wind rider from the Crossroads can find him among the city's tradesfolk. He receives their deliveries and directs messengers toward the local flight roosts.

faq.answer: Ahanu is a tauren merchant in Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise. He sells leather armor and helps couriers arriving from the Crossroads.
Ahanu sells basic leather armor, including jerkins, belts, boots, and bracers. The gear is made for hunters, rogues, and young adventurers.

faq.q: Where in Thunder Bluff can I find him?
faq.answer: Ahanu works inside Hewa's Armory on Thunder Bluff's lower rise, near other armorers, leatherworkers, and weapon smiths.
Young tauren adventurers bring goods to Ahanu by wind rider in 'Ride to Thunder Bluff'. Afterward, he sends them back to Tal, the city's wind rider master.

angles.text: As a young tauren brave arriving from the Crossroads by wind rider, you can find familiar hospitality and essential hides for the road with Ahanu.
